title: Let a full gate count when only new untracked debris appeared during the run (launcher outcome plus standing-approval wording)
outcome: Let a full gate count when only new untracked debris appeared during the run (launcher outcome plus standing-approval wording)
acceptance: When a run's after-fingerprint differs, the launcher reports a distinct outcome only if HEAD, the staged index and tracked content are exactly unchanged, the sole difference is newly created untracked non-ignored paths, and no pre-existing untracked path changed; it lists those paths (bounded) and keeps the actual stage results. Every other difference stays an input-changed failure. The original fingerprint is never reported as equal.

AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md (byte-identical) replace the standing approval's gate clause with the agreed wording, and /review-changes matches it: the gate counts with that outcome only when the integration owner records on the item what the paths contain and why they are non-input debris, and the committed tree excludes them.

Landed under the authority-text process: (a) both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording recorded on this item, (b) the exact wording and its consequence sent to Greg before landing, (c) the final-diff audit recorded as passed before landing. Greg's widening word is recorded verbatim with its source (see notes).
Launcher tests cover: unchanged input; only new untracked debris; a changed tracked file; a changed staged index; a changed pre-existing untracked file; ignored paths.
